items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I played with him when he first come back from California.

ctx.x: Yeah, Peter Lacoste. He was an excellent good player. He used to play the Silver Leaf Band, too, with me. And different men, you know, they had for the brass band.
You remember Manuel Perez. You didn't mention...
Yeah, I played with Manuel Perez, too.
